fn main() {
    let mut measurements = vec(9, 2, 7, 4)
    let mut sorted = vec()
    while measurements.len() > 0 {
        let mut min = measurements.get(0)
        for m in measurements {
            if m < min {
                min = m
            }
        }
        sorted = push(sorted, min)
        measurements = drop_all(measurements, min)
    }
    print_vec(&sorted)
}

fn drop_all(v: Vec<Int>, x: Int) -> Vec<Int> {
    let mut v = v
    for i in 0 < v.len() {
        if v.get(i) == x {
            v = drop_all(v, i)
        }
    }
    v
}

fn print_vec(v: &Vec<Int>) {
    for i in 0 < v.len() {
        print(v.get(i))
    }
}

fn print(x: Int) {
    print_str(to_str(x))
}

fn print_str(s: Str) {
    let stdout = get_global("std::io::stdout")
    stdout.write_str(s)
}

fn get_global(name: Str) -> T {
    return name
}
